findings.evidence: `Spa/RationalSubset/Basis.lean:105` defines `spaRationalFamily` using `IsOpen (Ideal.span (T : Set A))`, while `Presentation.lean:100-106` has no such field. These conditions are not interchangeable: `hasDenominatorPower_of_pow_le_span` accepts any `T` whenever a power of the ideal of definition lies in `(den)`, so for a non-discrete adic ring one may take `T = ∅` and a denominator generating that power although `span ∅ = ⊥` is not open.
findings.fix: Add the open-numerator-ideal condition (or an equivalent proved admissibility condition) to `Presentation`, and prove it for `prod` using the intersection openness theorem before constructing this index.
findings.issue: `Presentation` bundles only `HasDenominatorPower` and omits `IsOpen (Ideal.span (num : Set A) : Set A)`, although the rational basis requires the latter; consequently `presentationFunctor` cannot faithfully index rational subsets contained in an open.

summary: `Presentation` does not encode the roadmap’s admissibility condition, so the claimed refinement category contains objects that are not presentations of rational-basis members.
